trial_court: Court of SHRI SANJEEV KUMAR SINGH : ADMINISTRATIVE CIVIL JUDGE (CENTRAL) : DELHI - Petition No.: 682/1998, Unique ID No: 02401C0007731998

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Rukmani Devi, widow of Late Sh. Janak Raj

facts_of_case: Petitioner Rukmani Devi seeks succession certificate for debts and securities of deceased Janak Raj. Objections filed by Smt. Chandra claiming herself as legally wedded wife of the deceased.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the person who asserts a fact to prove it.
legal_principles.held: She further deposed that she did not know whether case under Section 2/3/4/5/6/7 SIT Act in the year 1987 vide FIR No. 131/1987 of PS Kamla Market, Delhi was registered against her or not.

legal_principles.principle: The principle of 'clean antecedents' is relevant in determining the legitimacy of a marriage.
legal_principles.held: She further deposed that petitioner Smt. Rukmani Devi was concubine of Late Janak Raj and she is not a lady of clean antecedents as she had been involved in cases of immoral trafficking

outcome.final_order: The court granted the petition seeking succession certificate to Rukmani Devi.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for succession certificate
